name: SVD Register Browser
blurb: a CMSIS-SVD file browsed: peripherals, registers and fields, and a register value decoded against it
intro: Reads a CMSIS-SVD file (derivedFrom, dim arrays and lists, clusters, enumerated values with don't-care bits, inherited size/access/reset) and decodes one register's value field by field, with each field's access (ro, wo, rw, w1c ...), its reset value and the meaning from enumeratedValues. It searches every peripheral, register and field name and description, finds the register at an address, and writes a CMSIS-style C struct with _Pos/_Msk macros for the peripheral. With no SVD it uses a built-in synthetic example device.

inputs.label: SVD file
inputs.help: The whole .svd XML. Empty: the built-in example device RLX32F1.

inputs.label: Register
inputs.help: A register path in the peripheral (clusters as CH[2].CCR), PERIPH.REG, or an absolute address.

inputs.label: Search
inputs.help: Finds peripherals, registers and fields by name or description.

examples.title: USART1 status read-back: TXE and IDLE set (built-in example device)
A pasted SVD with a derived peripheral: decode SPI2 CR1

usage: Give svd (the whole CMSIS-SVD XML; empty uses a built-in synthetic example), peripheral and register names (clusters as CH[2].CCR, or PERIPH.REG, or an absolute 0x address in register to find which register lives there), a value (0x/0b/decimal; empty = reset value) and optionally a search term. It returns the register's address, size, access and reset value, a table of every field with bits, access tag, value and enumerated meaning, the peripheral's register list, the device's peripheral list, search matches, and texts 'C expression' (the value written with field macros) and 'C header' (_Pos/_Msk macros for the register, or with header=peripheral the CMSIS-style struct and every macro). Warnings flag set bits outside any field, field values not in their enumerated list, and SVD errors (unresolved derivedFrom, overlapping fields or registers).
sources: Arm CMSIS-SVD format description, schema 1.3 (Apache-2.0): https://arm-software.github.io/CMSIS_5/SVD/html/svd_Format_pg.html - elements device, peripheral, cluster, register, field, enumeratedValues; dimElementGroup; derivedFrom; modifiedWriteValues; readAction; scaledNonNegativeInteger
The built-in example device RLX32F1 is synthetic, written for this tool
